sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshījié de lǐwù
sentences.english: Teacher's Day Gift

sentences.pinyin: Xīngqīwǔ zǎoshang, Lìlì hé dìdi Xiǎomíng yīqǐ chī zǎofàn.
sentences.english: On Friday morning, Lili and her younger brother Xiaoming had breakfast together.

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Jīntiān jiùshì jiàoshījié le, wǒmen gěi lǎoshī zhǔnbèi yīgè lǐwù ba!"
sentences.english: Lili said, "Today is Teacher's Day, let's prepare a gift for the teacher!"

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng gāoxìng de shuō: "Hǎo zhǔyì! Wǒ cóng huāyuán lǐ zhāi yīxiē xīnxiān de huā, nǐ xiě yī zhāng kǎpiàn, zěnmeyàng?"
sentences.english: Xiaoming happily said, "Great idea! I'll pick some fresh flowers from the garden, and you write a card, how about that?"

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì xiàole: "Hǎo a! Wǒ yào yòng zuì rènzhēn de hànzì xiě."
sentences.english: Lili smiled, "Okay! I'll write it with the most careful Chinese characters."

sentences.pinyin: Chī wán zǎofàn, liǎng gè rén mǎshàng kāishǐ zhǔnbèi.
sentences.english: After breakfast, the two immediately started preparing.

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì ná chū yī zhāng kǎpiàn, yī gè zì yī gè zì de xiě.
sentences.english: Lili took out a card and wrote it character by character.

sentences.pinyin: Tā xiě dé hěn màn, yīnwèi tā xiǎng ràng měi gè zì dōu yòu piàoliang yòu zhěngqí.
sentences.english: She wrote very slowly, because she wanted every character to be both beautiful and neat.

sentences.pinyin: Kǎpiàn shàng xiězhe: "Lǎoshī, xièxie nín měitiān rènzhēn de jiāo wǒmen.
sentences.english: The card read: "Teacher, thank you for diligently teaching us every day.

sentences.pinyin: Zhù nín jiàoshījié kuàilè!"
sentences.english: Happy Teacher's Day to you!"

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng zài huāyuán lǐ zhāile jǐ duǒ xīnxiān de huā, yǒu hóng de, yǒu huáng de.
sentences.english: Xiaoming picked several fresh flowers from the garden, some red, some yellow.

sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu, tā yòng cǎisè de zhǐ bǎ huā bāo qǐlái, zuò chéngle yī shù piàoliang de huā.
sentences.english: Then, he used colorful paper to wrap the flowers, making a beautiful bouquet.

sentences.pinyin: Dàole xuéxiào, tāmen bǎ lǐwù sòng gěile lǎoshī.
sentences.english: At school, they gave the gift to the teacher.

sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī dǎkāi kǎpiàn, kàndào piàoliang de huā, hěn gǎndòng de shuō: "Xièxie nǐmen!
sentences.english: The teacher opened the card, saw the beautiful flowers, and said with great emotion, "Thank you!

sentences.pinyin: Nǐmen hái jìde zūnjìng lǎoshī zhège chuántǒng, wǒ zhēn de hěn gǎndòng.
sentences.english: You still remember this tradition of respecting teachers, I'm really touched.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐmen zhēnshi hǎo xuéshēng!"
sentences.english: You are truly good students!"

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Lǎoshī, zhè shì wǒmen yīnggāi zuò de.
sentences.english: Lili said, "Teacher, this is what we should do.

sentences.pinyin: Xièxie nín měitiān de nǔlì!"
sentences.english: Thank you for your daily efforts!"

sentences.pinyin: Fàngxué yǐhòu, liǎng gè rén yīqǐ zǒulù huí jiā.
sentences.english: After school, the two walked home together.

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Lǎoshī jīntiān nàme gāoxìng, wǒ yě juédé hěn kāixīn."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "The teacher was so happy today, I feel very happy too."

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì xiàozhe shuō: "Duì! Lǎoshī měitiān dōu nàme nǔlì, wǒmen yǐhòu yào gèng nǔlì xuéxí, ràng lǎoshī fàngxīn."
sentences.english: Lili smiled and said, "Yes! The teacher works so hard every day, we should study harder in the future to make the teacher reassured."

sentences.pinyin: Liǎng gè rén yībiān zǒu yībiān shuō, xīnli yòu jiāo'ào yòu kuàilè.
sentences.english: The two walked and talked, feeling both proud and happy.
